units: all returns, distances and percents are fractions (0.05 = 5%)

data.reference_snapshots: reference tickers type=CS active=true as of the first XNYS session of each calendar quarter; a signal date D uses the latest snapshot with as_of <= D

hard_filter.adv20_definition: mean(raw close * raw volume) over the 20 sessions D-20..D-1 (D excluded, so the filter never selects on D's own volume)

corporate_action_exclusion.split_flag_window: any split (either direction) with execution_date in (session D-20, D]; ticker-date excluded from candidates AND controls
corporate_action_exclusion.ca_suspect_feature_window: any split-adjusted close-to-close ratio in D-19..D >= 3.0 or <= 1/3; ticker-date excluded from candidates AND controls
corporate_action_exclusion.label_ca_suspect: any split-adjusted ratio open(D+1)/close(D), or close(t)/close(t-1) or open(t)/close(t-1) for t in D+2..D+10, >= 3.0 or <= 1/3; label excluded for candidates AND controls, counted per group

features.return_kd: P(D)/P(D-k) - 1, P(t) = raw close(t) / F(t), F(t) = product of price factors of the ticker's splits executed <= t
features.rvol_20: V(D) / mean(V(D-20..D-1)), V(t) = raw volume(t) * F(t)
features.atr_pct: mean true range over D-14..D-1 on the split-normalized series / P(D-1) (pre-signal volatility; D excluded)
features.distance_52w_high: P(D) / max(H(D-251..D)) - 1, H(t) = raw high(t) / F(t)

buckets.rule: bucket = index of the last edge <= value; the last bucket is open-ended

C-M3.reason: sector/peer has no point-in-time source in V1 data

labels.window: sessions D+1..D+k, D itself never included
labels.close_return_k: C(last traded session <= D+k, and >= D+1) / P0 - 1
labels.close_return_k_from_d_close: secondary, not a gate input: C(D+k) / C(D) - 1
labels.time_to_mfe_k: 1-based session offset of the first session reaching the window high
labels.time_to_mae_k: 1-based session offset of the first session reaching the window low
labels.censoring: no bar on D+1 -> NO_ENTRY_BAR; ticker has no bar on or after D+k inside the dataset -> DISAPPEARED (horizon k excluded); counted per group

matching.control_population: same variant's eligible universe (hard filter + history + CA exclusions) minus that variant's candidates
matching.matched_base_for_a_candidate: control mean of the label in the candidate's cell (label-valid controls only)
matching.lift: sum(candidate hits) / sum(matched base probabilities) over label-valid matched candidates
matching.reference_only: unmatched lift vs the whole eligible universe of the same date, never a gate input

evaluation_windows.primary: signal dates with index 251..N-10 on the session grid (M2 warmup and 10D forward both available); all variants
evaluation_windows.secondary: signal dates with index 60..N-10; C-M0 and C-M1 only; descriptive
evaluation_windows.time_blocks: primary window split into 4 consecutive blocks of (near) equal signal-date count

statistics.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap over signal dates, block length 10 sessions, 2000 replicates, seed 20260917
statistics.ci: percentile; family-wise 3 variants -> two-sided 98.33% (Bonferroni) for the gate, 95% also reported
statistics.close_return_statistic: candidate mean close_return_10 minus matched control mean, both clipped to [-1, 1]

per_variant_conditions.8_concentration: single ticker share <= 0.05, top-5 tickers <= 0.15, single date share <= 0.05, top-10 dates <= 0.25

decision.PASS: at least one variant meets all 9 conditions
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: no variant passes, and some variant has lift point > 1 with conditions 2 and 3 met but fails only on 6, 7 or 8 (sample/concentration), or data depth prevents 4 time blocks
